name: document-skills
description: Office document suite: read, create, edit, validate and convert Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), PowerPoint (.pptx) and PDF files, with tracked changes, comments, formula recalculation, slide thumbnails and PDF forms.

steps.step: read, edit, comment or track changes in an existing Word file
write a new Word report, letter or proposal from scratch
build or audit a workbook with formulas, recalculation and error scan
inventory, edit, rebuild or thumbnail an existing deck
write a new presentation from a story and slide plan
extract text or tables, fill forms, merge, split or render a PDF
produce a new PDF from HTML or ReportLab
